result.topic_en: Section 75 of Ramanujan's manuscript gives Lambert-series formulas for powers of a modified Eisenstein-type series Q-bar and for products of theta series giving the number of representations by the forms m^2+2n^2, k^2+l^2+2m^2+2n^2, m^2+3n^2 and k^2+l^2+3m^2+3n^2.
result.transcription:
Add. ms a 94^{18(51)} (57) (95)
75. There are of course results corresponding to those of §§72-74 for the various powers of $\overline{Q}$, where
$\overline{Q} = 1 + 6\left(\frac{q}{1-q} - \frac{q^2}{1-q^2} + \frac{q^4}{1-q^4} - \frac{q^5}{1-q^5} + \cdots\right)$.
Thus for example
(402) $(\overline{Q})^2 = 1 + 12\left(\frac{q}{1-q} + \frac{2q^2}{1-q^2} + \frac{4q^4}{1-q^4} + \frac{5q^5}{1-q^5} + \cdots\right)$
(403) $(\overline{Q})^3 = 1 - 9\left(\frac{1^2 q}{1-q} - \frac{2^2q^2}{1-q^2} + \frac{4^2q^4}{1-q^4} - \frac{5^2q^5}{1-q^5} + \cdots\right)$
$+ 27\left(\frac{1^2q}{1+q+q^2} + \frac{2^2q^2}{1+q^2+q^4} + \frac{3^2q^3}{1+q^3+q^6} + \cdots\right)$
(404) $(\overline{Q})^4 = 1 + 24\left(\frac{1^3q}{1-q} + \frac{2^3q^2}{1-q^2} + \frac{3^3q^3}{1-q^3} + \cdots\right)$
$+ 8\left(\frac{3^3q^3}{1-q^3} + \frac{6^3q^6}{1-q^6} + \frac{9^3q^9}{1-q^9} + \cdots\right)$
The number of ways in which a number can be expressed in the forms $m^2+2n^2$, $k^2+l^2+2m^2+2n^2$; $m^2+3n^2$, and $k^2+l^2+3m^2+3n^2$ can be found from the following formulae.
(405) $(1+2q+2q^4+2q^9+\cdots)(1+2q^2+2q^8+2q^{18}+\cdots)$
$= 1 + 2\left(\frac{q}{1-q} + \frac{q^3}{1-q^3} - \frac{q^5}{1-q^5} - \frac{q^7}{1-q^7} + \cdots\right)$.
(406) $(1+2q+2q^4+2q^9+\cdots)^2(1+2q^2+2q^8+2q^{18}+\cdots)^2$
$= 1 + 4\left(\frac{q}{1-q^2} + \frac{2q^2}{1-q^4} + \frac{3q^3}{1-q^6} + \frac{4q^4}{1-q^8} + \cdots\right)$.
(407) $(1+2q+2q^4+2q^9+\cdots)(1+2q^3+2q^{12}+2q^{27}+\cdots)$
$= 1 + 2\left(\frac{q}{1-q} - \frac{q^2}{1+q^2} + \frac{q^4}{1+q^4} - \frac{q^5}{1-q^5} + \frac{q^7}{1-q^7} - \cdots\right)$.
(408) $(1+2q+2q^4+2q^9+\cdots)^2(1+2q^3+2q^{12}+2q^{27}+\cdots)^2$
$= 1 + 4\left(\frac{q}{1+q} + \frac{2q^2}{1-q^2} + \frac{4q^4}{1-q^4} + \frac{5q^5}{1+q^5} + \frac{7q^7}{1+q^7} + \cdots\right)$,
where 1, 2, 4, 5 ... are the natural numbers without the multiples of 3.
